en.title: Preliminary Enforcement Brief: Suspected Unauthorized Land Transformation in Wetland Buffer Area (DB-0001)
en.summary: Remote sensing detection on 2025-04-15 identified an anomaly over 1.42 hectares within the Wetland Buffer Area (WBA). Significant increases in radar backscatter (+5.9 dB) coupled with a negative NDWI delta (-0.35) indicate possible surface clearance, pond filling, or unpermitted storage/development activity lacking evident ecological impact mitigation.
evidence: Affected area covers 1.42 hectares within the Wetland Buffer Area (WBA).
Radar backscatter delta increased by 5.9 dB, consistent with structural change, ground disturbance, or earth filling.
NDWI delta decreased by -0.35, indicating reduction in surface water or moisture consistent with dewatering or filling.
statutory_basis: TPB PG-No. 12C Section 6.4: Intention of WBA to protect the ecological integrity of the fish ponds and wetland within the WCA.
TPB PG-No. 12C Section 6.5: Development or redevelopment requiring planning permission requires an ecological impact assessment demonstrating that negative impacts can be mitigated.
TPB PG-No. 12C Section 6.6: Applications for new open storage or container back-up uses within the WBA are normally not allowed due to adverse disturbance on birds.
en.recommended_action: Conduct site inspection to verify on-the-ground activities, cross-reference statutory planning registers for valid planning permissions or ecological impact assessment submissions, and issue advisory or statutory notice if unauthorized works are identified.
en.limitations: Findings are based on satellite radar and optical spectral indices and require on-site ground truthing and verification against Town Planning Board statutory records.

zh_hant.title: 初步執法摘要：濕地緩衝區內涉嫌未經授權的土地平整或改動 (DB-0001)
zh_hant.summary: 遙感監測於 2025-04-15 發現濕地緩衝區（WBA）內一處 1.42 公頃的異常變動。雷達後向散射增加 5.9 dB 且水體指數（NDWI）下降 0.35，顯示可能涉及地面平整、填塘或未經許可的露天存放及發展活動。
evidence: 受影響面積達 1.42 公頃，位於濕地緩衝區（WBA）。
雷達後向散射增加 5.9 dB，顯示地表結構改變、填土或構築物出現。
水體指數（NDWI）下降 0.35，反映水體或地表濕度顯著減少。
statutory_basis: 城規會規劃指引第 12C 號第 6.4 段：濕地緩衝區之規劃意向為保護濕地保育區內魚塘和濕地的生態完整性。
城規會規劃指引第 12C 號第 6.5 段：在濕地緩衝區內進行需規劃許可的發展必須提交生態影響評估，以證明負面影響得以緩解。
城規會規劃指引第 12C 號第 6.6 段：因對鳥類產生負面干擾，濕地緩衝區內的新露天存放或貨櫃後勤用途通常不獲批准。
zh_hant.recommended_action: 安排實地巡查以核實活動性質，查核法定規劃記錄以確認是否持有有效規劃許可或生態影響評估報告，並在確認違規情況下採取相應法定執行行動。
zh_hant.limitations: 初步評估僅基於衛星雷達及光學頻譜分析，須進行實地視察及核實法定規劃紀錄。
